summary: Rookie Jalon Daniels starts for Tampa Bay with Mayfield out, and Pittsburgh is a 2.5-point road favorite. The single leg most likely to win is the Pittsburgh Steelers ML.

legs.note: Two models project 40 points, Pittsburgh has scored 29.3 a game since Week 3, and the total has dropped below that.

extra_legs.note: Rodgers and a top-three offense by EPA (Weeks 3-5) face a rookie QB and a Bucs secondary missing Winfield.
Every Bucs game has been one score, and they come in at home on 10 days of rest.
Opposing tight ends have topped 71 yards against Tampa every game, and Pittsburgh is missing two receivers.

research:
Two passes, 35 searches in total. Pass 1 had 20 searches; it hit the shared budget, then pass 2 added 15. WebFetch failed with DNS errors, so all findings come from search snippets.
1) QBs. PIT: Aaron Rodgers is 110/184 (59.8%) for 1,234 yds (~247/g) through 5 games. Week 5 vs IND he went 22/31, 235 yds, 3 TD, 0 INT (125.1 rating) in a 34-22 win. Vs CIN he threw 292 yds and 3 TD (30-27 W). In 2025 he was 24th of 33 in EPA/play and 32nd in success rate. TB: Mayfield (dislocated right thumb, Week 3) missed practice Wed and Thu, and OC Zac Robinson said he is 'not quite ready,' so he is out. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels (ex-Kansas) is 38/55 (69.1%) for 337 yds through 3 games and has never thrown for 200. He had 148 yds vs GB (line 171.5) and 189 vs DAL (line 184.5) with 1 TD, 0 INT and 7-23 rushing. FantasySP projects 189 pass yds and Yardbarker 195-235. I found no posted Daniels or Rodgers yardage line for this game, so neither prop is included.
2) Injuries. No Friday designations or inactives were found; this uses the Wed/Thu reports (Buccaneers.com, Steelers.com, Yardbarker, Roundtable). TB: S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) DNP both days, expected out 2-4 weeks. Godwin took a rest day and was full Thu. Sean Tucker (quad) limited. PIT: WRs Roman Wilson (finger) and Ben Skowronek (calf) were ruled OUT by McCarthy. DT Keeanu Benton (ankle) went DNP then limited and is uncertain; DT Derrick Harmon is on IR. CB Ramsey (wrist) was limited but will play. S DeShon Elliott (knee) was limited. RB Rico Dowdle (toe) was full. Watt and Heyward were full Thu.
3) Advanced stats. Over Weeks 3-5 (Yardbarker), PIT ranked 3rd in offensive EPA (0.166), 9th in success rate (47.3%), 2nd in rush EPA (0.154) and 13th in dropback EPA, and scored 29.3 ppg. PIT has 11 sacks in 5 games and allowed 265+ pass yds in each of the last two games. It held Jonathan Taylor to 45 yds and ranks 13th in fewest rush yds allowed. TB's 2025 defense was 17th in EPA/play and 20th in success rate, and its pass defense was 27th from Week 10 on. In 2026 TB has allowed the 3rd-most yards to TEs, with TEs going over 71 yds in every game (SIS via AtoZ). USA Today ranks the TB defense 21st. TB lost 17-14 to GB but held them to 283 yds. Bucky Irving ran for 165 yds (5.3 ypc) vs DAL and is the clear lead back; Yardbarker projects 70-100 yds, but I found no posted line.
4) Matchup. Freiermuth has 19 rec, 169 yds and 4 TD (33.8/g). He had 44 yds and 2 TD in Week 5, when PIT's slot WRs had zero catches. With Wilson and Skowronek out, his volume should rise against a TB defense that leaks yards to TEs. Rookie WR Germie Bernard averages 15 yds/g; I passed on his o41.5 prop.
5) Coaching. PIT is coached by Mike McCarthy (first year), reunited with Rodgers. TB is coached by Todd Bowles, who calls the defense, with Zac Robinson at OC.
6) Situational. TB has 10 days of rest after the Thursday Oct 8 game at DAL and plays at home. PIT is on normal rest after the Oct 11 game and has to travel. Non-divisional game, 1 PM ET on CBS.
7) History. Last regular-season meeting: PIT won 20-18 in 2022. Not predictive.
8) Weather. No forecast for game day was found. Mid-October Tampa is typically warm with a chance of afternoon showers. No adjustment made.
9) Market and experts. Spread: DK opened PIT -3; FanDuel now PIT -2.5 (-115) / TB +2.5 (-105). ML: PIT -144 / TB +122. Total: FanDuel 40.5 (O -105 / U -115), Kalshi and Predictem 39.5, ESPN consensus 38.5. Kalshi gives PIT 56% to win and has the spread at 50/50. Expert picks: Covers analyst TB +2.5; Predictem TB +2.5; Squawka model PIT 23-17 (about 60%) with Under 42.5; numberFire PIT 54.2%; DeFi Rate model PIT 21-19; YouWager PIT -2.5 (projects a 7-point margin), TB team total Under 19.5 (-120) and Freiermuth o35.5 (-110, projection 42). Both models project about 40 total points, above the 38.5 consensus, so the total flipped from Under to Over. Prop fair value of 0.5 assumes -110/-110 at a single book.
